data.one_liner: Hides sensitive data in the app switcher and provides automatic lock triggers with native lifeCycle listeners.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that hides sensitive app data using privacy screens on iOS and FLAG_SECURE on Android when the app enters the background. It also provides automatic app locking mechanisms via native lifecycle listeners.
use_when: You need to hide sensitive content when the app is in the background or app switcher.
You want to implement an automatic lock screen triggered by native lifecycle events after a set duration.
avoid_when: You need a package that is actively maintained, as this plugin is unmaintained.
You require custom privacy views on Android (Android forces a black/white screen via FLAG_SECURE).
strengths: Uses native app lifecycles instead of Flutter's to ensure proper behavior when entering native views.
Supports custom privacy images and blur effects on iOS.
Provides a native lifecycle events stream and customizable lock gates.
weaknesses: The plugin is explicitly marked as no longer maintained.
Android does not support custom privacy views and disables screenshots globally when enabled.
Lock screens cannot be presented on top of active native views on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding privacy_screen to pubspec.yaml and configuring native assets (like LaunchImage on iOS) if custom images are desired.
data.minimal_example:
bool result = await PrivacyScreen.instance.enable(
    iosOptions: const PrivacyIosOptions(
        enablePrivacy: true,
        privacyImageName: "LaunchImage",
        autoLockAfterSeconds: 5,
        lockTrigger: IosLockTrigger.didEnterBackground,
    ),
    androidOptions: const PrivacyAndroidOptions(
        enableSecure: true,
        autoLockAfterSeconds: 5,
    ),
    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
    blurEffect: PrivacyBlurEffect.extraLight,
);
